(b) DESIGN CONTRADICTION, reported and deliberately NOT resolved in either direction: 4 gives HGO scope.action the two exact values GUARD.OVERRIDE.CONSUME.SIGNATURE|CHAT, while 7.5 says the action comes 'from the consumption mode' - but HGO's `mode` is standard|pipeline-author-repair|global-plugin-install, never signature/chat. Signature-vs-chat is HGO's authorization CHANNEL (authorizeHumanGuardOverrideBySignature vs the in-session activation gated on gates.push_approval === 'chat', human-guard-override.mjs:1687-1690), and the capability carries no channel field. I therefore made `authorizationChannel` a required caller parameter over the closed set {signature, chat} and encoded no mapping from `mode`; the derivation belongs to the CLI dispatch that is out of scope here. (c) Design gaps filled, disclosed: the design requires a lazy `expired` disposition for a window but names no reason code - I used GUARD.MAINTENANCE.EXPIRED, completing the GUARD.MAINTENANCE.CLOSED/NOT_ARMED family; and 7.3 specifies identifiers only for GMW, so the HGO path uses the same scheme under an `hgo-` producer prefix (the helpers keep `gmw` as default, so 7.3's literal contract is unchanged) plus a fifth helper denyDecisionId for the `denied` event 7.5 requires and 7.3 gives no id for. (d) A GMW subject carrying a `reasonCode` that fails the CODE pattern fails closed (GAL-REASON-CODE) rather than degrading to WINDOW_UNATTESTED; 5.3's fallback is for a subject with no such field. (e) Layer-1 HGO artifacts are a caller-supplied [{path,sha256}] set because reading bytes is I/O; the builder intersects it with capability.eligiblePaths so a caller cannot inject an unbound artifact (test pins this). (f) Commit discipline: the briefing asks for staging+commit as ONE bundled shell call, but the project's own guard grammar rejects `&&`, so it was two pathspec-scoped calls. The environment's mandated commit trailers (Co-Authored-By provider trailer and Claude-Session URL) were rejected by git-guard GIT-03, which offers no override; the message uses `AI-Assisted: true` instead.

(ii) GUARD.MAINTENANCE.EXPIRED and the hgo-* id scheme should be pinned in the design (or corrected) before the reconcile dispatch depends on them. (iii) buildAppendIntent maps an absent featureId to the typed state {state:'unavailable'}; 7.2 names that state only for policy digests, so confirm it rather than 'not-applicable' for the HGO path. (iv) AC-1/AC-6/AC-8 remain open for the wiring and integration dispatches. (v) The design's stale line citations in 3.3/5.5/7.3/10.2 should be refreshed at the next rebind.
